original_title: Echocardiography Insourcing
english_summary: This tender is for the provision of BSE accredited echocardiographers to perform adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiograms (TTE) at NHS South West facilities. Services include both outpatient studies at multiple community diagnostic centres and inpatient scans at Royal Cornwall Hospital Trust (RCHT) using GE echo machines, with reporting through the Maxims EPR system.
what_they_want: BSE accredited echocardiographers to deliver adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiograms (TTE) using GE Echo machines at RCHT sites including Bodmin, WCH Community Diagnostic Centres, and RCHT Truro. original_title: HS2 OCS - Occupational Health Services (OHS)
